name: 20070429.hoopoe.flac
description: a Serin sings close, then enters a distant Hoopoe call, an airplane, other birds (Great Tit, Blackbird, Serin, Sparrow), flies, distant detonations... Recorded in Pine-Wild Olive forest-Scrub near Puebla del Río, S Spain (Doñana area). I like a lot the weird screeching sound you can hear several times in this recording (1:10-1:30) but can make no suggestion as to source. Can you help? ME66 + MKH30 mics to Shure FP24 and Iriver H120, M/S decoded

name: 20080321.warblers.can.sing.3.hoopoe.flac
description: Blackcap singing amazingly, a Hoopoe and other birds in background, just a couple minutes. I recorded several hours of this which I can upload if you really like, that would give me be the perfect excuse to reach the top of the uploads list :-)

name: 20090408.morning.chorus.wav
description: Peaceful morning ambiance with birds singing (mostly Hoopoe, chatter from nesting House Martins, House Sparrow and Pigeons), but also some bangs and human voices. Recorded near Tavira (Algarve, Portugal) in a place where the acoustics was unbelievably good (see Geotag). I used two Shure WL183 capsules into a FEL preamp and an Edirol R09 recorder

name: 20070407.morning.hoopoe.flac
description: lots of birds singing near Bernabe House (Carcabuey, Spain), fluttering of wings can be heard on occassions. Sennheiser ME66+MKH30 into Shure FP24, recorded in iRiver H320, decoded to M/S stereo with Voxengo free VST plugin

name: 20130418_starling.02.flac
description: Starling callings at country house near Castelo de Vide (Alentejo, Portugal). Audiotechnica BP4025, Shure FP24 preamp, PCM-M10 recorder. When a Starling decides to sing loud there's not much you can do to avoid a clipped recording, sorry

name: Little Bittern and Great reed warber songs in the Salagou lake
description:
In the foreground, the regular Little Bittern (Ixobrychus minutus), and the squeaky  great reed warbler (Acrocephalus arundinaceus). In the background: #0:1.77 European Oriole, #1:27.502 Hoopoe, #0:14.22 Philomène Nightingale,  #1:16.441 fish jump
Very close and good !

Au premier plan, le régulier Blongios nain, et les grinantes Rousseroles turdoïdes. Au second plan : Loriot d'Europe, Huppe Fasciée, Rossignol Philomène (...?)



Salagou Lake (Herault France)
Micro AT4041 ORTF and Mixpre-6

Attribution is greatly appreciated but not required.

name: 20100523.sitontop.canoe.wav
description: peaceful spring morning ambiance as heard from a canoe on a large reservoir in S Spain: singing birds (Blackbird, Hoopoe, Corn Bunting), water moved by paddles, and bangs from oars that strike the boat every now and then. Recorded at Zufre reservoir using two Shure WL183 capsules (each side of my backpack), Fel preamp, Olympus LS10 recorder
